Question B-003-001-008.

Why the correct answer is right: In the station order used here, the SWR meter follows the low-pass filter so it reads the match after the transmitter output has been filtered.

Why the distractors are wrong:
- sourceIndex 1: "The last stage of RF amplification": The last RF amplification stage is upstream of the low-pass filter; the meter is not inserted immediately after that stage in this layout.
- sourceIndex 2: "The antenna tuner": Putting the meter after the tuner would measure a different point and would not show the transmitter-side match in the illustrated chain.
- sourceIndex 3: "The antenna switch": The antenna switch is downstream; placing the meter after it would move the match reading away from the transmitter accessory sequence.
